note: Lean needs `δ₀ ≥ 2` so that `2Q ≤ √x`, and proves coprimality to all `q ≤ 2Q` (not to every `q ≤ √x`); it then feeds `hcop` to the Bombieri identity. The `Hence` part is the display of step 5.

snippet.text:
have hcop : ∀ n, a n ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime n L := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨hp, hnx⟩ := hsupp n hn
    refine Nat.Coprime.prod_right fun q hq => ?_
    obtain ⟨hq1, hq2⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq
    refine (Nat.coprime_or_dvd_of_prime hp q).resolve_right fun hdvd => ?_
    have hle := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd
    have : (q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q := le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hq2) (Nat.floor_le (by positivity))
    have : (n : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hle
    linarith

proof_context.conclusion: Every `n` with `aₙ ≠ 0` (prime `> √x`) is coprime to `L = ∏_{q ≤ 2Q} q`, so `Nat.Coprime n q` for every `q ≤ 2Q` (a prime `n > √x ≥ 2Q ≥ q` cannot divide `q`).
